items.description: A member legitimately NAMED `items`. Dropping segments by text cannot tell this from the keyword, so the name would be lost and this subschema would collide with a sibling.

throughItems.description: A path continuing past a single-schema `items`. Only the tuple form consumes what follows, so `items` is kept and the trailing `properties` dropped — swallowing the next segment would name this after `properties` instead.
